block.note: 3 gym mornings before the Jacksonville trip. Same A/B/C split as last week, but at least half the moves are new variations so Week 2 is not a rerun of Week 1. Rests 45s main / 30s accessories. No lunges. Targets are a small bump on lifts you already logged, or conservative starts on new ones — stay there if form slips.

warmUp: Use the app's Quick Warm-Up card (bodyweight squats, glute bridges, arm circles or light face pulls, bird dogs).
finisher: Optional 5 min easy StairMaster. Skip if you're short on time.

days.name: Mon 11/23 – Gym A: Glutes + Quads + Abs

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (DB)
exercises.note: New. Hold one DB at your chest, elbows in, sit between your heels, chest up. Start at 45 lb; drop to 40 if the last reps get sloppy.

exercises.name: 45-Degree Back Extension (glute focus)
exercises.note: New. Pad at your hips, hinge from the hips, squeeze glutes to rise until your body is a straight line. Stop short of arching your lower back. Add a light DB only if bodyweight is easy.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction
exercises.note: New. Low pulley with an ankle cuff or handle, stand tall, lift the working leg out to the side without leaning. 25 lb is a starting point.

days.name: Tue 11/24 – Gym B: Back + Chest + Abs

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.goal: Was 30-40x12; try 45x10-12, drop to 40 if form slips

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-up (Gravitron)
exercises.note: New. Use the Gravitron instead of the pulldown. Start with plenty of assist so you get 8-10 smooth reps, no swinging. Less assist on the next set if it felt easy.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Chest Press
exercises.note: New. Handles at mid-chest on the cable crossover or Freemotion, slight stagger, press forward without shrugging. 40 lb per handle is a conservative start.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.note: New. Chest on an incline bench, row the DBs, squeeze your shoulder blades, don't shrug. Start at 30 lb each hand.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press
exercises.note: New. Stand sideways to a mid-height cable, press the handle straight out and pause, resist the twist. 20 lb is plenty to start.

days.name: Wed 11/25 – Gym C: Glutes + Hams + Abs

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge (DB on hips)
exercises.note: New. Upper back on the floor or bench, DB on the working-side hip, other foot off the floor, drive through the heel and squeeze at the top. 30 lb is a conservative start.

exercises.name: Leg Curl Machine
exercises.goal: Was 40-60x12-14; stay at 60 and push 14-15 clean reps

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.goal: Was 20x12; try 25x12. Rotate from your core, not your arms.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.goal: Hold the 90s you already logged; use auto 2nd side if you do both

exercises.name: Cable Crunch or Hanging Knee Raise
